newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Reuters beeper gives Tel Aviv stock data.
newsitem.headline: Reuters beeper gives Tel Aviv stock data.

text.p: Reuters Israel, a subsidiary of Reuters Ltd, on Tuesday introduced its new Pocketwatch pager with data from the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.
The pager contains prices of the stocks traded in the Maof 25 and Mishtanim 100 indices which update every five minutes, the company said.

The service includes other financial information such as updates on interbank shekel trading, representative rates for the shekel, prices of Israeli stocks traded in the United States and international stock indices.
The Pocketwatch also has a limit minder service for traders, the first of its kind in Israel. The pager will send a personal message when a limit set by the user on any instrument is reached.
The pager costs $110 a month, plus a $20 a month stock exchange fee.
Reuters officials said they expect a few hundred customers for its new Pocketwatch service within a month.
The Pocketwatch is a service provided by Beeper Communications Israel Ltd, which is owned by Motorola's Israeli subsidiary and Pagecall.
Reuters Israel also has a forex pager Pocketwatch which currently has several hundred clients in Israel.
